# openinfra_model_monitor (Resource)

Scheduled data-drift monitoring for a deployed model (SageMaker Model Monitor) — a CronJob that compares recent data to a baseline, computes per-feature drift, and reports violations. `threshold` (a float) is set via the console or kubectl (default 0.2).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Resource name. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `baseline` (Attributes) The reference dataset drift is measured against. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--baseline))
- `current` (Attributes) Where recent data/predictions to check live (JSONL under this prefix). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--current))
- `features` (List of String) Numeric feature names to monitor. Empty = every numeric field in both datasets.
- `model_ref` (String) The openinfra_model endpoint this monitors (informational).
- `namespace` (String) Kubernetes namespace. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `output` (Attributes) Where drift reports are written (bucket created on demand). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--output))
- `schedule` (String) Cron schedule (default hourly).

### Read-Only

- `cron_job` (String) The CronJob that runs the monitor.
- `id` (String) `namespace/name`, the import identifier.
- `ready` (Boolean) Whether the resource's Ready condition is True. Terraform returns as soon as the object is accepted, so this is usually `false` immediately after apply — the platform reconciles asynchronously.
